title: A Comprehensive Review of Recommender Systems: Transitioning from Theory to Practice

bias_targets.methodology: As a survey paper, it reviews literature evaluating demographic biases in recommender systems. It categorizes evaluation and mitigation methods into pre-processing (e.g., resampling protected groups), in-processing (e.g., adversarial learning, fairness-aware regularization), and post-processing (e.g., calibrated re-ranking) techniques.

The survey reviews research on how recommender systems disproportionately favor popular items, summarizing the evaluation of LLM-based and foundational models designed to balance accuracy, diversity, and popularity bias mitigation.

The paper reviews methodologies in news recommender systems that evaluate filter bubbles, echo chambers, and ideological polarization, highlighting metrics such as the Gini Index, polarization scores, and unfairness metrics.
